studies.title: The spherical Earth
studies.caption: Aristotle argues the Earth is a sphere: the curved shadow it casts on the Moon in an eclipse, and stars that rise or vanish as a traveller goes north or south.
studies.prompt: Restrained ancient Greek observation scene near Athens about350BCE: two observers on a rocky terrace watch a partially eclipsed moon with a visibly curved dark shadow. Broad night sky, small human scale, no telescopes, no globe covered with modern continents, no labelled diagrams.
